name: North Ridge

pitch_detail.notes: Scramble from Cathedral Pass to where roping up is worthwhile.
Several steeper steps/notches with up to 5.5 climbing to the summit plateau; 5-7 pitches total depending on rope-up point and pitch length chosen.

descent_text: From the summit plateau, either reverse toward Cathedral Pass and drop southwest around the mountain to Upper Cathedral Lake, or head to a small col just southwest of the North Ridge and downclimb a 3rd-class gully on the north slope back toward the approach.
approach: Backpack to Upper Cathedral Lake/Cathedral Pass as for the West Route, then scramble to the base of the north ridge from the pass.
overview: A 5-7 pitch, 5.5 alpine ridge climb up Amphitheater Mountain's blunt north ridge from Cathedral Pass, mixing scrambling with several short, steeper roped steps to the broad summit plateau.
beta: From Cathedral Pass, scramble up to a point where roping up becomes worthwhile, then follow the blunt north ridge through several steps of up-to-5.5 climbing, with route-finding and loose blocks in places, topping out on Amphitheater's broad summit plateau. Terrain includes sections of loose boulders.
gear: rock shoes or sturdy approach boots
